title: W07 to W02 Membership Access-State Binding

principal.source: W01 authenticated subject forwarded by W07 without client override

currentW01Boundary.actor: W01-facing transition requests are restricted to actor=user; W07 derives actor from the authenticated W01 subject and does not accept a client-selected actor.
currentW01Boundary.entitlementAction: W07 derives entitlementAction from target state: ACTIVE→GRANT, CANCELED/EXPIRED→REVOKE, otherwise NONE; client input is not authoritative.

defenseInDepth.userScope: W02 requires actor=user transitions to target a subscription whose subscriber_id equals X-LuckRead-Principal-User-Id.
defenseInDepth.entitlementScope: W02 REVOKE requires entitlement_id to belong to the same subscription_id being transitioned.

authorization.futureTrustedActors: system/creator/admin/payment require a separately admitted trusted authority path; they are not reachable through the current W01-facing transition boundary.

rules: W02 never accepts payment provider credentials or client-authoritative subscription state.
W07 decides the lifecycle transition; W02 persists only after validating current status and expectedVersion.
Subscription version is persisted in D1-01 and incremented atomically.
Entitlement grants/revokes, when required, are written in the same D1-01 atomic batch as the accepted subscription transition.
No D1-01 write is exposed to W01 or public clients.
